content: The last total solar eclipse before the year 2000 occurred on August 11, 1999. This eclipse was notable for being visible across parts of Europe, including a path of totality that crossed through parts of the United Kingdom, France, Belgium, Germany, Austria, Hungary, Romania, and Turkey. It was widely observed and considered one of the most-watched solar eclipses up to that point.
